title: AGD Supercharges Its Streamers: Roon Ready and Qobuz Connect Arrive for Allegro, Andante, and Alto
summary: AGD Productions has released a significant firmware update for its high-end Allegro, Andante, and Alto streamers, bringing Roon Ready certification and Qobuz Connect integration. This upgrade, developed with AudibleHQ, promises enhanced user experience, advanced connectivity, and future-proofed performance for audiophiles seeking seamless, high-resolution audio.
content:
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA – In a significant move set to delight high-fidelity audio enthusiasts, AGD Productions today announced a sweeping firmware upgrade for its acclaimed Allegro, Andante, and Alto streamer lineup. This major overhaul of AGD’s digital architecture introduces full Roon Ready certification and seamless Qobuz Connect integration, solidifying the brand’s commitment to cutting-edge performance and user experience in the premium audio space.

The collaboration with AudibleHQ has culminated in an update that transforms the AGD streamers into even more versatile and powerful digital hubs. For audiophiles, the "Roon Ready" designation is a game-changer, meaning these devices can now effortlessly discover and connect to Roon Core, offering unparalleled access to Roon's rich metadata, intuitive browsing, and multi-room audio capabilities. Navigating vast music libraries and discovering new artists becomes an immersive experience, all while maintaining the pristine audio pathways AGD is known for.

Beyond Roon, the inclusion of Qobuz Connect allows direct streaming of high-resolution audio files from the Qobuz platform, bypassing intermediate apps for a purer signal path. This direct integration ensures that listeners can tap into Qobuz's extensive catalog of studio-quality music with utmost convenience and fidelity, making the search for sonic perfection even easier. Crucially, the update also brings Over-the-Air (OTA) capabilities, ensuring that AGD's digital architecture remains current with future enhancements and bug fixes, providing a future-proof investment for discerning listeners. This isn't just an upgrade; it’s a commitment to an evolving, high-performance listening ecosystem.
keyTakeaways: AGD's Allegro, Andante, and Alto streamers now feature Roon Ready certification for enhanced navigation and multi-room audio.
The firmware upgrade integrates Qobuz Connect, allowing direct, high-resolution audio streaming from the Qobuz platform.
Over-the-Air (OTA) updates are now enabled, ensuring continuous improvements and future-proofing for AGD's digital audio architecture.
author: TAS Staff
